nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Extract descriptive prompts or selling-point text from one or more images.

duration.description: Target duration in seconds. Used by video-reclone analysis.

imageUrlList.description: Public image URLs used for analysis. Provide no more than 6 images for modes that accept multiple images.

provider.description: Analysis provider. Supported values: API_PRE_POINT (default), API_LAYOUT_DESC.

refVideoUrl.description: Reference video URL. Required when type is 89.

targetLanguage.description: Target language for generated text. Used by video-reclone analysis.

type.description: Analysis type. Supported values: 5 (similar-image prompt), 13 (scene prompt), 30 (image-to-video analysis), 69 (apparel selling points), 71 (product selling points), 73 (sales-video script), 89 (video-reclone prompt).

name: nexscope_image_captioning
title: Image Captioning API
